# UA Campaign Actuals: Weekly Performance Export
**UA Manager 2 | Channels: Meta, TikTok, Google UAC, Snapchat, Programmatic**

---

## Week of April 7–13, 2026

### Channel Totals

| Channel | Spend | Installs | Blended CPA | Blended ROAS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Meta | $44,200 | 4,250 | $10.40 | 1.8x |
| Google UAC | $31,500 | 3,490 | $9.03 | 2.2x |
| TikTok | $9,600 | 1,030 | $9.32 | 1.7x |
| Snapchat | $3,100 | 380 | $8.16 | 1.3x |
| Programmatic | $5,200 | 420 | $12.38 | 1.2x |
| **TOTAL** | **$93,600** | **9,570** | **$9.78** | **1.85x** |

### Campaign-Level Breakdown

| Channel | Campaign | Spend | Installs | CPA | ROAS | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Meta | Prospecting — Broad | $18,500 | 1,850 | $10.00 | 1.8x | — |
| Meta | Prospecting — Lookalike | $12,200 | 1,100 | $11.09 | 1.6x | ⚠️ Bottom |
| Meta | Retargeting | $4,800 | 520 | $9.23 | 2.4x | ✅ Top |
| Meta | Sports Fan Targeting | $8,700 | 780 | $11.15 | 1.4x | ⚠️ Bottom |
| TikTok | UGC Spark Ads | $6,400 | 720 | $8.89 | 1.9x | ✅ Top |
| TikTok | In-Feed Trending Hooks | $3,200 | 310 | $10.32 | 1.5x | — |
| Google UAC | App Campaign — tCPI | $22,000 | 2,600 | $8.46 | 2.1x | ✅ Top |
| Google UAC | App Campaign — tROAS | $9,500 | 890 | $10.67 | 2.3x | — |
| Snapchat | Snap Audience Network | $3,100 | 380 | $8.16 | 1.3x | — |
| Programmatic | DV360 — Sports Content | $5,200 | 420 | $12.38 | 1.2x | ⚠️ Bottom |

### Top Campaigns
1. **Google UAC tCPI** — $8.46 CPA / 2.1x ROAS (highest volume + efficiency)
2. **Snapchat Audience Network** — $8.16 CPA (lean but efficient)
3. **Meta Retargeting** — $9.23 CPA / 2.4x ROAS (best ROAS)

### Bottom Campaigns (Action Required)
1. **Programmatic DV360** — $12.38 CPA → reduce budget 20%, shift to Google UAC
2. **Meta Sports Fan Targeting** — $11.15 CPA → creative refresh or audience tightening
3. **Meta Prospecting Lookalike** — $11.09 CPA → test new seed audience
